A vulnerability exists in the handling of the R_MICROMIPS_GPREL7_S2 relocation, which is intended for the 16-bit LWGP instruction (0x6400/0xfc00 match/mask encoding in `micromips_opcodes`). The relocation is specified to operate on a half-word by the howtos in elf32-mips.c, elfn32-mips.c, and elf64-mips.c, but is incorrectly subject to shuffle/unshuffle in code such as _bfd_mips_elf32_gprel16_reloc. This causes the relocation to be applied to the wrong byte: to byte 0x22 in big-endian and to byte 0x33 in little-endian, instead of the correct byte. Additionally, there are issues with REL addend extraction from section contents and with overflow checking. In gold, all of these problems are present, and it also fails to apply the required right shift by two. Functions and files affected include micromips_reloc_shuffle_p and mips_elf_calculate_relocation in elfxx-mips.c, should_shuffle_micromips_reloc and relgprel in mips.cc, and related test cases in the ld testsuite.src-vul/fuzz_ranlib_simulation.c

    symtab_sz = 16
    strtab_off = symtab_off + symtab_sz
